definitions.explanation: All members of a group; everyone present. Often used in formal contexts like letters and speeches.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧{一同|いちどう}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧。
{一同|いちどう}、⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: We all offer our heartfelt congratulations.

examples.japanese: ⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧{一同|いちどう}、お⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: All the staff look forward to seeing you.

notes:
{一同|いちどう} follows a group noun to mean "all of us" in formal writing and speeches: cards, letters, signs, and greetings on behalf of a group.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧{一同|いちどう}: all the employees
- ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧{一同|いちどう}: the whole family
- ⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧{一同|いちどう}: all the staff
- 〜{一同|いちどう}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧: from all of (used to sign a card or gift)
